title: Audit log export for the internal audit unit

articles.subject: Audit log export for the internal audit unit
articles.body:
Hello,

Our internal audit unit will sample decisions from the spring call. They want the audit log for a set of cases as a file they can keep, not a screen they scroll.

Is there an export, and what does it contain? They will ask whether the export itself is logged.

Best regards,
Elin Sund
Data protection officer

articles.subject: Re: Audit log export for the internal audit unit
articles.body:
Hi Elin,

There is an export per case from the audit tab, as CSV, containing timestamp, actor, action and the affected field. There is no bulk export across a selection of cases today, which I suspect is what your audit unit actually wants.

And yes, the export action is itself written to the log.

Let me check with our developers what a selection-based export would take, and come back to you.

Best,
Mia Berg

articles.subject: Audit log export for the internal audit unit
articles.body: No estimate yet on the bulk export. Reminder moved to 18 Sep. Elin's audit unit starts sampling in October, so this has a real deadline even if nobody has said so.
